name: Loong
description: Loong is a long-context benchmark for evaluating large language models on extended multi-document question answering tasks, emphasizing realistic scenarios where all documents are relevant and must be considered to answer correctly.
reputation: A very recent long-context QA benchmark that is still emerging in the community and has not yet become a standard reference point.
notes: Introduces four task types (Spotlight Locating, Comparison, Clustering, Chain of Reasoning) and avoids artificial noise extension in context length.
